answers.question: Draft badge background exact hex: appears warm orange/peach but not determinable from PNG. Which token should be used?
answers.answer: Map to the nearest existing warm token in tokens.css (e.g., --color-warning-bg or equivalent amber/peach surface token). Do not add new tokens; developer selects closest existing token that matches warm orange/peach. Mark for design QA if token doesn't exist.

answers.question: Archived badge background exact hex: appears muted gray/beige but not determinable from PNG. Which token should be used?
answers.answer: Map to the nearest existing neutral surface token in tokens.css (e.g., --color-neutral-100 or --color-surface-muted). Do not add new tokens; developer selects closest existing token that matches muted gray/beige. Mark for design QA if token doesn't exist.

answers.question: Column header text color appears to be --color-primary-action (#F97316) but could be a lighter orange variant. Which value is correct?
answers.answer: Use --color-primary-action (#F97316) directly — consistent with other interactive/accent text throughout the app.
